description: This file is a C source code for a program that initializes and starts the 'parodus' process, including configuration, system info gathering, and process management.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that initializes system, gathers system info, configures and starts the parodus process, and manages process lifecycle.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Reads device properties file to fetch parodus and seshat URLs and build type.

methods.name: getPartnerId
methods.description: Retrieves partner ID from syscfg or external script.

methods.name: addParodusCmdToFile
methods.description: Writes the constructed parodus start command to a file.

methods.name: _START_LOG
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and level to stderr or stdout.

methods.name: getValueFromCfgJson
methods.description: Reads a key's value from webpa_cfg.json, parsing JSON content.

methods.name: writeToJson
methods.description: Writes JSON data to webpa_cfg.json file.

methods.name: getWebpaValuesFromPsmDb
methods.description: Fetches WebPA parameter values from PSM database via command execution.

methods.name: getValuesFromPsmDb
methods.description: Prepares parameter list and calls getWebpaValuesFromPsmDb.

methods.name: setValuesToPsmDb
methods.description: Sets parameter values in PSM database via command execution.

methods.name: getValuesFromSysCfgDb
methods.description: Fetches configuration values from syscfg database.

methods.name: syncXpcParamsOnUpgrade
methods.description: Synchronizes parameters during firmware upgrade based on reboot reason and firmware version.

methods.name: free_sync_db_items
methods.description: Frees allocated memory for parameter value arrays.

methods.name: get_parodusStart_logFile
methods.description: Reads device properties to get the log file path for start_parodus.

methods.name: checkServerUrlFormat
methods.description: Checks if server URL matches expected format with at least two colons.

methods.name: checkAndUpdateServerUrlFromDevCfg
methods.description: Validates and updates server URL from device config JSON if format is incorrect.

methods.name: waitForPSMHealth
methods.description: Polls PSM component health status until it is green or timeout occurs.

methods.name: executeConfigFile
methods.description: Runs external configuration script and checks for generated response file.
